comment: Manifest of the SIMC++ physics notes (docs/physics/README.md). Built in this order by docs/physics/build_physics_pdf.py: 00_common first (the reaction notes reference its labels through xr-hyper). 'copies': source-tree directories that receive a generated copy of the PDF when the notes are published (target physics_pdf).

notes.title: Common elements: frames, kinematics, weighting, event chain, radiation, energy loss, Coulomb
H(e,e'p) elastic scattering (reaction hydrogen_elastic, model sigep)
D(e,e'p) and A(e,e'p) quasi-elastic knock-out (reactions deuterium_eep, nucleus_eep, model deforest)
A(e,e')A nuclear elastic scattering (reaction nuclear_elastic, model nuc_elastic)
